blurb: Guests can enjoy craft beers on tap at two taprooms, including a main street location and the original brewery taproom. The brewery offers a semi-private brewhouse space for events accommodating about 24 seated guests, with access to the main taproom and outdoor patio. A fat bike and brewery tour includes a guided ride, brewery visit, tasting, and return transportation.
extraNote: Food may be brought in or catered; no kitchen onsite · Guests must remove all food scraps, trash, and decorations after event · Taproom private closure for events is rare and by arrangement · Brewhouse bookings mostly available after 5 PM, schedule dependent · 68 Continental Court, Unit B12, Breckenridge, CO 80424
